reason: Keep mem_reserve at exactly 5 GiB. The crash disassembly shows the VoxelSceneHeap allocation request is 0xb0e00000 (2,830 MiB), and the heap allocator returns NULL; the caller then performs an atomic access at null+0xc8. Rebalance the same 5 GiB guest reservation: front 256 MiB + alias 32 MiB + stack 192 MiB + app_pool 4,640 MiB. This reclaims 96 MiB from the alias/stack reservations for the app heap; no increase to mem_reserve and no shader/framework rebuild.
